name: a109-sim
$comment: The flyable A109: Heffley & Mnich's model with the drivetrain bond graph, ground effect, a switchable SCAS and the demonstration pilot (hover, transition and climb, a coordinated 20 deg bank turn, deceleration to hover), with the FMU interface as export markers. Generated by design/build_model.py; see the README.

annotations.text: **Airframe.** RigidBody3D on its principal axes (the report's Ixz tilts them 10.49 deg from the body x axis). Each component is a modulated wrench source at its own point: ExternalWrenchSpatial bonded through a FixedTransform3DNeutral that carries the offset, so the bond graph forms r x F.

**Components** (modulated sources): the report's main rotor (flapping, thrust/inflow), fuselage, tail rotor, tailplane and fin, in SI. Their forces act at the hub, the fuselage point, the tail-rotor hub, the tailplane and the fin.

**Drivetrain** (rotational bond graph, ours): the rotor inertia on its 1-junction with the aerodynamic torque; the mast 0-junction (common torque) whose flows make rotor speed = gearbox speed + airframe yaw rate (ShaftAxis, the reaction torque on the airframe); the gearbox 1-junction with the engine torque (Governor), the transmission losses and the tail-rotor gear (TF) to the tail-rotor junction and its torque.

**Schedule and feedforward.** UCmd, HCmd and PhTurn give the demonstration's forward speed, height and bank over time; the FF_* tables the trim attitude, collective and control angles over the forward airspeed (the trim sweep of design/heli_sim.py at 15 m).

**Pilot and inputs.** DemoPilot flies the schedule by stick (speed by pitch attitude, height by collective, the turn by bank); the ExportInputPass markers pass its sticks and a calm wind through in bg-sim, in the FMU the host drives them.

**Rigging and SCAS.** Rigging maps the sticks to the blade angles with the percent-of-travel fits; the SCAS (switch `scas`) holds the attitude, commands the yaw rate and coordinates the turn, or passes the rigging's angles.

parameters.name: scas
parameters.description: 1: SCAS on (attitude command / hold, yaw-rate command, turn coordination); 0: sticks direct

parameters.name: demo
parameters.description: 1: the demonstration pilot flies the schedule; 0: hold the hover sticks

parameters.name: smooth
parameters.description: 1: the report's hard switches (fin and tailplane stall, wake edge, dihedral magnification) blended over a narrow band (ours, keeps the closed loop from chattering); 0: the report's switches

parameters.name: coll_off
parameters.description: collective offset added from t_inp (fraction of travel)

parameters.name: lon_off
parameters.description: longitudinal cyclic offset added from t_inp (-1 .. 1, + forward)

parameters.name: lat_off
parameters.description: lateral cyclic offset added from t_inp (-1 .. 1, + right)

parameters.name: ped_off
parameters.description: pedal offset added from t_inp (-1 .. 1, + right)

options.text: The demonstration pilot hovers at 15 m, accelerates and climbs to 70 kt, flies a coordinated 20 deg bank turn, decelerates and hovers again. Turn the **demo** off to hover hands-off, add stick offsets from 1 s, or switch the **SCAS** off and watch the bare helicopter diverge.
